devī.p: [Deva+ī.(deī-prā)] (thī) Google Translate (1) Queen. (2) Goddess. devī Devi (Hti) [Yadisanam] (1) A woman by the name of Devi. See original
pn:
Devī. Mother of Mahinda and Saṅghamittā and wife of Asoka.

She was the daughter of Deva of Vedisagiri.

Asoka met and married her while on his way to Ujjenī, there to become Viceroy.

When he became king, Devī continued to live at Vedisagiri (Mhv.xiii.6ff; Dpv.vi.16; Vin-a.i.70).

She is sometimes called Vedisadevī (Mhv-ṭ.324).
a: (၁)မိဖုရား။(၂)နတ်သမီး။ devī ဒေဝီ(ထီ) [ယဒိစ္ဆာနာမ်] (၁)ဒေဝီအမည်ရှိသော အမျိုးသမီး။(၂)b.e. ၂၁၈-၂၅၅-တွင် ပါဋလိပုတ်ပြည်၌ နန်းတက်သော ဓမ္မာသောကမင်း၏ဇနီး, မဟိန္ဒနှင့် သံဃမိတ္တာတို့၏ မိခင် ဒေဝီ။ မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။

She was the daughter of Deva of Vedisagiri.

Asoka met and married her while on his way to Ujjeni，there to become Viceroy．

When he became king，Devī continued to live at Vedisagiri （Mhv.xiii.6ff； Dpv.vi.16； Sp.i.70）．

She is sometimes called Vedisa-devī （MT.324）.
